clinical_intent: During applicator reconstruction for a cervical cancer brachytherapy plan, the physicist discovers that the CT images show the tandem is 1.5 cm shorter than expected based on the actual applicator length. This discrepancy would result in incorrect source dwell positions. Investigate the possible causes of this reconstruction error and describe the corrective actions.
